stemMd: Elena: A city should preserve every old factory because each records part of its industrial history. Farid: Some factories can be documented thoroughly and then demolished when preservation would prevent essential housing. They disagree about whether

options.label: B
options.textMd: old factories can have historical value.

options.label: D
options.textMd: historical value always requires preserving the physical factory.

options.label: E
options.textMd: new factories should use old machinery.

explanationMd: Elena's rule applies to every old factory. Farid allows demolition in at least some cases despite historical value. Their disagreement is about the universal obligation to preserve the physical structure.

distractorRationale.a: Elena does not deny that possibility.
distractorRationale.c: Farid refers only to essential housing.
